Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix download failures: Add robust retry logic and rate limiting protection

Problem: "ERROR: The downloaded file is empty" errors caused by YouTube rate limiting

Solution:
- Add 10 retries for downloads and fragments
- Implement 1-3 second sleep intervals between downloads
- Set modern User-Agent header for better compatibility
- Skip unavailable fragments instead of failing
- Keep warnings enabled for better debugging

Technical changes:
- download.py: Enhanced yt-dlp options with retry logic, sleep intervals, and User-Agent
- CLAUDE.md: Added troubleshooting section and download stability documentation
- README.md: Added troubleshooting section for download failures

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix format availability: Make format selection more flexible

Problem: "Requested format is not available" error during validation/download

Solution:
- validate.py: Use simple ''best'' format instead of ''bestaudio/best'' for validation \(no download anyway\)
- download.py: Use flexible format chain with multiple fallbacks
  - Try m4a audio first \(most common\)
  - Fall back to webm audio
  - Fall back to any best audio
  - Final fallback to best format
- Remove extract_flat option that could cause issues
- Add allow_unplayable_formats: False for safety

This makes downloads work even when YouTube blocks specific formats

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix validation format check: Use ''worst'' format to avoid restrictions

Problem: YouTube still blocks validation with format errors

Solution:
- Use ''worst'' format for validation \(least restrictive\)
- Remove extract_flat and no_check_formats which don''t help here
- We only need metadata \(title, description\) for validation
- Using ''worst'' format makes YouTube less likely to block the request

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
